title: Observation
description: A single sensing event emitted by any perception source onto the bus.

v.description: Envelope version. Bump only on a breaking change.

id.description: Unique message id (uuid4 hex). Set by the bus if absent.

source.description: Namespaced emitter id, e.g. screen_copilot, vera.mic, kyger.oak_d

type.description: Observation kind and the bus routing subkey.

payload.description: Type-specific body. Envelope is strict; payload is open unless a per-type validator is registered.
